title: Lesson 37 · The Olympic Games
titleZh: 第37课 奥林匹克运动会

examples.en: The Olympic Games will be held in our country.
examples.zh: 奥林匹克运动会将在我们国家举行。

examples.en: We won the football game.
examples.zh: 我们赢了那场足球赛。

examples.en: The Games will be held just outside the capital.
examples.zh: 运动会将在首都郊外举行。

examples.zh: 会议将于下周举行。

examples.zh: 政府将建造新的旅馆。

examples.zh: 他在当地政府工作。

examples.en: They will build new hotels for the visitors.

examples.en: We are all very excited.
examples.zh: 我们都非常兴奋。

examples.zh: 孩子们对这次旅行很兴奋。

examples.en: We are looking forward to the Olympic Games.

sentences.en: The Olympic Games will be held in our country in four years.
sentences.zh: 四年以后，奥林匹克运动会将在我们国家举行。

sentences.en: They will also be building new roads and a special railway line.
sentences.zh: 他们还将修建新的道路和一条专用铁路线。

sentences.en: The whole area will be called Olympic City.
sentences.zh: 整个地区将被称为奥林匹克城。

sentences.en: By the end of next year, the workers will have finished work on the new stadium.
sentences.zh: 到明年年底，工人们将建成新的体育场。

sentences.en: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 我们都非常兴奋，盼望着奥运会的到来。

article.en: The Olympic Games will be held in our country in four years.
article.zh: 四年以后，奥林匹克运动会将在我们国家举行。

article.en: As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels, an immense stadium and a fine new swimming pool.
article.zh: 由于将有大批的人来我国访问，政府将建造新的旅馆、一个大型体育场和一个漂亮的新游泳池。

article.en: They will also be building new roads and a special railway line.
article.zh: 他们还将修建新的道路和一条专用铁路线。

article.en: The Games will be held just outside the capital.
article.zh: 运动会将在首都郊外举行。

article.en: The whole area will be called Olympic City.
article.zh: 整个地区将被称为奥林匹克城。

article.en: By the end of next year, the workers will have finished work on the new stadium.
article.zh: 到明年年底，工人们将建成新的体育场。

article.en: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter.
article.zh: 这些壮观的现代化建筑是由库尔特·冈特设计的。

article.en: Everybody will be watching anxiously as the new buildings go up.
article.zh: 当新建筑拔地而起时，人人都将焦急地注视着。

article.en: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games.
article.zh: 我们都非常兴奋，盼望着奥运会的到来。
